tasks.title: Improve runtime configuration handling
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current configuration handling in backend/config.py and .env.example.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve runtime configuration ergonomics, moving towards environment variables.
[CONSTRAINTS] Keep secrets out of the repository. Prefer deterministic tests. Touch only backend/config.py, backend/, tests/, and .env.example.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Config handling is more robust, relying on env vars, and tests verify configuration parsing.

tasks.title: Refactor a small backend area
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current backend codebase.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Refactor one small backend area to improve readability or reduce duplication.
[CONSTRAINTS] Preserve existing behavior. Add or update tests when practical. Touch only backend/ and tests/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Code is refactored for better readability/maintainability, and all tests pass.

tasks.title: Document setup and operations
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current README.md, docs/, AGENTS.md, and mission.md.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve setup documentation for local development, secrets, GitHub Actions, and validation.
[CONSTRAINTS] Do not change application code. Touch only docs-related files.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Setup instructions are clearer, more comprehensive, and accurate based on current repository state.

tasks.title: Improve skills error handling
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current error handling in backend/skills/.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve error handling to return consistent, typed errors instead of generic exceptions.
[CONSTRAINTS] Keep the diff small. Write async, type-hinted code. Touch only backend/skills/ and tests/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Error handling is more robust and tested.

tasks.title: Add frontend unit tests
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current frontend test coverage.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Add unit tests for frontend utility functions (e.g. in frontend/js/ui.js).
[CONSTRAINTS] Avoid real DOM manipulations if possible, test pure functions. Touch only frontend/tests/ and frontend/js/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] New unit tests pass and improve frontend test coverage.

tasks.title: Validate metrics
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current state of metrics.json.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Validate and update current project metrics format to ensure alignment with factory principles.
[CONSTRAINTS] Use 4-part RECURSIVE META-PROMPTING PROTOCOL for prompts. Do not change application code. Touch only metrics.json.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] metrics.json is updated, and formatting is consistent.

tasks.title: Review code quality
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current state of codebase and docs/ARCHITECTURE_STATE.md.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Review code quality across recent PRs and update architecture state.
[CONSTRAINTS] Ensure no code changes. Touch only docs/ARCHITECTURE_STATE.md.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] ARCHITECTURE_STATE.md correctly captures recent technical decisions and structural changes.

tasks.title: Review dependencies
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current dependencies in backend/requirements.txt.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Review backend dependencies for known vulnerabilities and document safe upgrade paths.
[CONSTRAINTS] Touch only requirements.txt and docs.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Dependencies are safely upgraded and documented.
